dedupe_keys.name: planification des espaces maritimes zones des cartes des vocations facades maritimes de metropole

description: Planification des espaces maritimes - zones des cartes des vocations (façades maritimes de métropole) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geolittoral.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. This layer represents the areas of the vocation maps of the strategic documents of the Eastern Channel – North Sea, North Atlantic – West Channel, South Atlantic and Mediterranean documents. Vocation maps are the first planning of maritime spaces carried out over all waters under jurisdiction. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Maritime Space Planning – Vocation Map Areas (Metropolitan Maritime Façades)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include espaces maritimes, dsf, vocations, planification. The listing shows 2024-02-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
